key_idea: Block i occupies positions i(i-1)/2+1 .. i(i+1)/2, so find i by inverting the triangular number and reduce the offset over i.
sketch: Estimate i from the square root of 8n-7 and fix it up with integer while-loops so that i(i-1)/2 < n <= i(i+1)/2. The offset k = n - i(i-1)/2 - 1; print i alone when k = 0, otherwise i and k/i divided by gcd. O(1) plus the gcd. Use 64-bit (n up to 4e9 overflows int) and do not trust floating sqrt without the integer correction.
